 2. Munni Devi Wife Of Amod Mandal R/O Village- Sabda, P.S.- Falka
 (Pothia), District- Katihar.
 ... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Bimal Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Ms. Pushpa Sinha, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
2 15-06-2023 Heard Mr. Bimal Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No.8 of 2019, in which cognizance has been taken for the offence under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the complainant (O.P. No.2) about three years ago.
However, soon after her marriage, she was subjected to demand of dowry and on non- fulfillment of the same, she was harassed and torture at the hands of the petitioner and his family members.

She alleged that Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.19912 of 2023(2) dt.15-06-2023 her husband (petitioner) has solemnized another marriage and,
as such, she is not ready to reside with the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that still there is a chance of settlement between the parties by making one time payment and, as such, he sought that notice may be issued to the O.P.
No.2 in order to procure her opinion.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the O.P. No. 2,
under both processes i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks.
List the case after receipt of the service of notice or on 28.07.2023, whichever is earlier.
In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with the aforenoted complaint case.

(Harish Kumar, J) rohit/-
